newsitem.title: EU: European Court of Justice Diary for July 14-18, 1997.
newsitem.headline: European Court of Justice Diary for July 14-18, 1997.

text.p: EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR JULY 14-18, 1997
(The diary is intended for quick reference only. It is
published subject to amendments. It does not bind the

09.30 - Opinion C-1/96 Compassion in World Farming: Free movement of goods. Preliminary ruling - High Court of Justice (Queen's Bench Division) - Export of calves - Possibility for a Member State to rely on Article 36 of the EC Treaty where there exists a harmonization directive laying down minimum conditions for the protection of calves which are less strict than those laid down in a Convention to which all the Member States have become parties and which has been approved by a decision of the Council. Advocate General: Leger. - Hearing C-3/96 Commission v Netherlands: Environment and consumers. Failure of Member State to fulfil obligations - Articles 5 and 189 of the EC Treaty - Failure to create enough special protection zones within the meaning of Article 4(1) of Council Directive 79/409/EEC on the conservation of wild birds.

10.30 - Hearing C-162/96 A. Racke: External relations. Request for a preliminary ruling - Bundesfinanzhof - Validity of Council Regulation (EEC) No 3300/91 of 11 November 1991 suspending the trade concessions provided for by the Cooperation Agreement between the European Economic Community and the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia (OJ 1991 L 315, p. 1).

09.30 - Opinion C-49/92 P Commission v Anic Partecipazioni: Competition. Appeal against the judgment of the Court of First Instance in Case T-6/89 - Application for annulment of the judgement in case T-6/89 - Polypropylene. Advocate General: Cosmas. - Opinion C-51/92 P Hercules Chemicals v Commission: Competition. Appeal against the judgment of the Court of First Instance in Case T-7/89 - Application for annulment of the judgement in case T-7/89 - Finding of non-existence of the Commission's decision - Infringement of Article 85 of the EEC Treaty - Polypropylene. Advocate General: Cosmas. - Opinion C-199/92 P Huls v Commission: Competition. Appeal against the judgment delivered on 10 March 1992 by the Court of First Instance in Case T-9/89 - Annulment of judgement T-9/89 - Finding as to the non-existence of the Commission decision - Infringement of Article 85 of the EEC Treaty - Polypropylene. Advocate General: Cosmas. - Opinion C-200/92 P ICI v Commission: Competition. Appeal against the judgment delivered on 10 March 1992 by the Court of First Instance in Case T-13/89 - Annulment of judgement T-13/89 - Finding as to the non-existence of the Commission decision - Infringement of Article 85 of the EEC Treaty - Polypropylene. Advocate General: Cosmas. - Opinion C-227/92 P Hoechst v Commission: Competition. Appeal against the judgment of the Court of First Instance in Case T-10/89 - Application for annulment of the judgement in case T-10/89 - Finding of non-existence of the Commission's decision - Infringement of Article 85 of the EEC Treaty - Polypropylene. Advocate General: Cosmas. - Opinion C-234/92 P Shell v Commission: Competition. Appeal against the judgment given by the Court of First Instance in Case T-11/89 - Application for annulment of the judgement in case T-11/89 - Finding of non-existence of the Commission's decision - Infringement of Article 85 of the EEC Treaty - Polypropylene. Advocate General: Cosmas. - Opinion C-235/92 P Montecatini v Commission: Competition. Appeal against the judgment given by the Court of First Instance in Case T-14/89 - Application for annulment of the judgement in case T-14/89 - Finding of non-existence of the Commission's decision - Infringement of Article 85 of the EEC Treaty - Polypropylene. Advocate General: Cosmas. - Opinion C-245/92 P Chemie Linz v Commission: Competition. Appeal against the judgment of the Court of First Instance in Case T-15/89 - Application for annulment of the judgement in case T-15/89 - Finding of non-existence of the Commission decision - Infringement of Article 85 of the EEC Treaty - Polypropylene. Advocate General: Cosmas. - Opinion C-5/93 P DSM v Commission: Competition. Appeal against the order made by the Court of First Instance in Case T-8/89 REVI - Setting aside of the judgment in Case T-8/89 - and the Polypropylene decision. Advocate General: Cosmas. - Opinion C-68/96 Grundig Italiana: Taxation. Preliminary ruling - Tribunale Civile e Penale, Trento - Interpretation of Art. 95 of the EC Treaty - Tax on consumption of audio-visual and photo-optical products - National law specifying different taxable values for national products and similar imported products. Advocate General: Lenz. - Opinion C-259/96 P Council v De Nil and Impens: Staff Regulations of Officials. Appeal in staff case. Advocate General: Elmer.

09.30 - Judgment C-28/95 Leur-Bloem: Taxation. Preliminary ruling - Gerechtshof te Amsterdam - Interpretation of Article 177 of the EC Treaty - Implementation of a provision of a Community directive resulting from the national implementing legislation which brings within the scope of the directive situations not covered by it - Interpretation of Articles 2(d) and 11(1)(a) of Council Directive 90/434/EEC on the common system of taxation applicable to mergers, Divisions, transfers of assets and exchanges of shares concerning companies of different Member States - Exchange of shares - Concept. Advocate General: Jacobs. - Judgment C-130/95 Giloy: Free movement of goods. Preliminary ruling - Hessisches Finanzgericht - Interpretation of Article 244(2) of Council Regulation (EEC) No 2913/92 establishing the Community Customs Code - Existence of good reason to believe that the disputed decision is unlawful and fear of irreparable damage for the person concerned - Alternative or cumulative conditions for suspension of implementation. Advocate General: Jacobs. - Judgment C-183/95 Affish: Agriculture. Preliminary ruling - College van Beroep voor het Bedrijfsleven - Validity of Commission Decision 95/119/EC concerning certain protective measures with regard to fishery products originating in Japan - General prohibition on the importation of consignments of fishery products originating in Japan following a finding by a mission of Community experts of serious failures with regard to hygiene - Principles of proportionality and equal treatment - Interpretation of Article 19 of Council Directive 90/675/EEC laying down the principles governing the organization of veterinary checks on products entering the Community from third countries. Advocate General: Cosmas. - Judgment C-334/95 Kruger: Agriculture. Preliminary ruling - Finanzgericht Hamburg - Validity of Council Regulation (EEC) No 804/68 on the common organization of the market in milk and milk products, and in particular the Annex thereto as amended by Regulation (EEC) No 374/92 in that Regulation No 374/92 does not provide for export refunds in respect of the milk contained in coffee essence or extract based food preparations - Consequences of possible invalidity - Interpretation of Council Regulation (EEC) No 2913/92 establishing the Community Customs Code - Suspension of the enforcement of a decision concerning customs - Application concerning export refunds - Interpretation of the second paragraph of Article 177 of the EC Treaty - Questions asked by a lower court - Appeals which may lead to indirect control of the questions asked by the court of first instance. Advocate General: Elmer. - Opinion C-15/96 Schoning-Kougebetopoulou: Freedom of movement for persons. Preliminary ruling - Arbeitsgericht, Hamburg - Interpretation of Article 48 of the EC Treaty and Article 7(1) and (4) of Council Regulation No 1612/68 on freedom of movement for workers within the Community - Collective agreement for public-sector workers providing for automatic advancement after a certain period of employment under that agreement which precludes taking into account inter alia employment in the public sector of another Member State. Advocate General: Jacobs. 111111 DED:BC-DIARY-COURT =2 European Court of Justice Diary for July 14-18 (page 2/3)

09.30 - Judgment C-17/96 Badische Erfrischungs-Getranke: Approximation of laws. Preliminary ruling - Bundesverwaltungsgericht - Interpretation of Council Directive 80/777/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to the exploitation and marketing of natural mineral waters - Concepts of properties favourable to health and certain effects (Annex I, Definition 1(a) and 2) - Water whose properties favourable to health are attributable to a very low sodium content. Advocate General: Elmer. - Judgment C-142/96 Wacker Werke: Free movement of goods. Preliminary ruling - Bundesfinanzhof - Interpretation of the second subparagraph of Art. 13(29 of Council Regulation (EEC) No 2473/86 on outward procesing relief arrangements and the standard exchange system. Advocate General: Tesauro. - Opinion C-80/96 Quelle Schickedanz: Free movement of goods. Preliminary ruling - Hessisches Finanzgericht Kassel - Validity of Annex 6 to Commission Regulation (EC) No 1966/94 concerning the classification of certain goods in the combined nomenclature - Classification under two different headings of a combination comprising a brassiere and briefs set up for retail sale - Interpretation of General Rule 3b for the Interpretation of the Combined Nomenclature. Advocate General: Fennelly. - Opinion C-248/96 Grahame: Freedom of movement for persons. Reference for a preliminary ruling on the validity and interpretation of Regulation No 1408/71, Annex VI Special procedures for applying the legislations of certain Member States, Part J (Netherlands), point 4 Application of the Netherlands legislation on insurance against incapacity for work, (a) and (c) - exclusion of periods of compulsory military service and enlisted service with the armed forces from the periods to be taken into account for calculating a pro rata disablement benefit. Advocate General: Cosmas.

09.30 - Opinion C-125/96 Simon: Agriculture. Preliminary ruling - Hessisches Finanzgericht Kassel - Interpretation of Commission Regulation (EEC) No 1546/88 laying down detailed rules for the application of the additional levy referred to in Article 5c of Regulation (EEC) No 804/68 - Retrospective fixing of additional amount following an insufficient first declaration - Date levy becomes due and obligation to pay interest for delay. Advocate General: Elmer.

09.30 - Opinion C-143/96 Leonhard Knubben Speditions: Free movement of goods. Preliminary ruling - Bundesfinanzhof - Interpretation of subheading 0904 20 of the combined nomenclature 1989 and 1990, crushed ... fruits of the genus Capiscum or the genus Pimenta - Goods cut into pieces of 4 to 8 mm. Advocate General: La Pergola.

09.30 - Opinion C-270/96 Laboratoires Sarget: Free movement of goods. Interpretation of Council Regulation No 1010/86 laying down general rules for the production refund on certain sugar products used in the chemical industry - Interpretation of Chapters 21 and 30 of the Common Customs Tariff - Products Sargenor, Sarvit, Lysivit and Dynamisan. Advocate General: Elmer.

15.30 - Hearing C-325/96 Fabrica de Queijo Eru Portuguesa: Free movement of goods. Preliminary ruling - Supremo Tribunal Administrativo - Interpretation of Art. 14(2) of Council Regulation (EEC) No 1999/85 on inward processing relief arrangements and of Arts 27 and 28 of Council Regulation (EEC) No 3677/86 laying down provisions for the implementation of Regulation (EEC) No 1999/85 (as amended by Council Regulation (EEC) No 2281/88) - Possibility of extending the time-limit set for the export of products under inward processing relief arrangements - Special arrangement for milk sector products (Art. 28 of Regulation No 1999/85 as amended)

09.30 - Judgment C-97/95 Pascoal & Filhos: External relations. Preliminary ruling - Tribunal Tributario de Segunda Instancia - Interpretation of Council Decision 86/283/EEC on the association of the overseas countries and territories with the European Economic Community, Annex II, Arts 10(1) and 25(3) - Interpretation of Council Regulation 2913/92 establishing the Community Customs Code, Art. 201/3 and of general principles (justice, legal certainty, good faith, proportionality) in relation to an action for a posteriori recovery from an importer who in good faith submitted documents EUR 1 containing incorrect information on the origin of the goods. Advocate General: Cosmas. - Judgment Joined Cases C-248/95, C-249/95 SAM Schiffahrt: Transport. Preliminary ruling - Oberverwaltungsgericht fur das Land Nordrhein-Westfalen - Validity of Council Regulation (EEC) No 1101/89 on structural improvements in inland waterway transport, Commission Regulation (EEC) No 1102/89 laying down certain measures for implementing Regulation 1101/89, and Commission Regulation (EEC) No 3685/89 amending Regulation 1102/89 - Scrapping premium system - Assessment of the effectiveness of provisions based on Article 75(1)(c) of the EC Treaty. Advocate General: Jacobs. - Opinion C-116/96 Reiseburo Binder: Taxation. Preliminary ruling - Bundesfinanzhof - Interpretation of Art. 9(2)(b) of the Sixth Council Directive 77/388/EEC on the harmonization of the laws of the Member States relating to turnover taxes - Common system of value added tax: uniform basis of assessment - Bus transport on an organized transfrontier trip - Criteria for apportioning prices between the different national sections. Advocate General: La Pergola. - Opinion C-284/96 Tabouillot: Taxation. Interpretation of Article 95 of the EC Treaty - Establishing the fiscal horsepower value of motor vehicles - Method that places imported vehicles at a disadvantage compared with similar vehicles sold in France. Advocate General: Jacobs. - Hearing C-324/96 Odette N. Petridi: Agriculture. Preliminary ruling - Eirinodikeion Echinou - Interpretation and validity of Council Regulation (EEC) No 727/70 of 21 April 1970 on the common organization of the market in raw tobacco, as amended by Regulations (EEC) Nos 1114/88 and 1252/89 - Phased reduction in production premium by reference to quantity.

09.30 - Judgment C-90/94 Haahr Petroleum: Free movement of goods. Preliminary ruling - Ostre Landsret - Interpretation of Articles 9 to 12, 13, 84 and 95 of the EC Treaty - National provisions in the field of tax on the use of public and private commercial ports affecting domestic and imported products - Additional tax of 40% exclusively on imported goods. Advocate General: Jacobs. - Judgment Joined Cases C-114/95, C-115/95 Texaco: Free movement of goods. Preliminary ruling - Oestre Landsret - Interpretation of Arts 9 to 13, 18 to 29, 86, 90 and 96 of the EC Treaty, of Council Regulation (EEC) No 4055/86 applying the principle of freedom to provide services to maritime transport between Member States and between Member States and third countries and of Council Regulation (EEC) No 4056/86 laying down detailed rules for the application of Articles 85 and 86 of the Treaty to maritime transport - Interpretation of the EC-Sweden and EC-Norway free trade agreements concerning national rules on taxes for the use of public and private ports which provide for a higher rate of 40% for the unloading of imported goods. Advocate General: Jacobs. - Judgment C-190/95 ARO Lease: Taxation. Preliminary ruling - Gerechtshof te Amsterdam - Interpretation of Article 9(1) of 77/388/EEC: Sixth Council Directive of 17 May 1977 on the harmonization of the laws of the Member States relating to turnover taxes - Common system of value added tax: uniform basis of assessment - Place where a service is provided - Operational lease of motor vehicles in a Member State other than that in which the undertaking is established. Advocate General: Fennelly. - Judgment C-219/95 P Ferriere Nord v Commission: Competition. Appeal against the judgment of the Court of First Instance (First Chamber, delivered on 6 April 1995, in Case T-143/89 - Refusal to annul Commission Decision 89/515/EEC relating to a procedure pursuant to Article 85 of the EC Treaty (IV/31.553 - Welded-steel mesh).Advocate General: Leger. 111113 DED:BC-DIARY-COURT =3 European Court of Justice Diary for July 14-18 (page 3/3) - Judgment C-242/95 GT-Link: Free movement of goods. 9 to 13, 74 to 84 and 95 of the EC Treaty - Interpretation of Articles 35 to 37 of the 1972 Act of Accession - Public commercial ports tax on national and imported goods - Additional (40%) tax solely on imported goods - Interpretation of Articles 86 and 90(2) of the EEC Treaty - Levying by a public undertaking of a public commercial port tax on national and imported goods - Additional (40%) tax solely on imported goods - Exemption from tax for vessels belonging to the undertaking concerned and to its subsidiary - National taxes incompatible with Community law - Recovery of the amount wrongly paid. Advocate General: Jacobs. - Judgment C-354/95 Farmers' Union and Others: Agriculture. Preliminary ruling - High Court of Justice (Queen's Bench Division) - Interpretation of Article 9 of Commission Regulation (EEC) No 3887/92. Advocate General: Leger. - Judgment C-52/96 Commission v Spain: Staff Regulations of Officials. Failure of a Member State to fulfil its obligations - Article 5 of the EC Treaty and Article 11(2) of Annex VIII of the Staff Regulations of Officials of the European Communities - Failure to take the measures necessary to enable pension entitlements of officials to be transferred to the Community system. Advocate General: Leger. - Judgment C-43/97 Commission v Italy: Company law. Failure of Member State to fulfil its obligations - Failure to adopt the laws, regulations or administrative provisions necessary to comply with Council Directive 93/36/EEC of 14 June 1993 coordinating procedures for the award of public supply contracts. Advocate General: Lenz. - Hearing C-100/96 British Agrochemicals Association: Agriculture. Preliminary ruling - High Court of Justice (Queen's Bench Division) - Interpretation of Council Directive 91/414/EEC concerning the placing of plant protection products on the market - National legislation providing for a simplified authorization procedure for products regarded as identical to a reference product for which a normal authorization exists - Simplified authorization for parallel imports
Judicial vacation from Monday 21 July to Friday 12 September inclusive

15.00 - Judgment T-81/95 Interhotel v Commission: Social policy. Partial annulment of the Commission's Decision of 28 December 1994 reducing the financial assistance initially granted by the European Social Fund for training following the annulment by the Court (judgment of 7 May 1991) of the first decision to reduce the fund's financial assistance. - Judgment T-123/95 B v Parliament: Staff Regulations of Officials. Staff case.
